content:
Let the original number be \(x\). The new number after moving the last digit 3 to the front is

\[
300+\frac{x-3}{10}.
\]

Set this equal to \(3x+1\):

\[
300+\frac{x-3}{10}=3x+1.
\]

Multiply by 10:

\[
3000+x-3=30x+10
\]

\[
2997+x=30x+10
\]

\[
2987=29x
\]

\[
x=103.
\]

\[
\boxed{103}
\]
